title: Better Dogs
description: Adds vanilla-like features to improve dogs.
body:
### **Better Dogs**

Adds multiple new blocks and changes to enchance vanilla wolfs. 

### **Dog Beds**
![All 16 variants of dog beds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27606af0b89d6aeab1c65a73b69b6a82d68b2e1b.png)
![Dog bed recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42cd7486d7717cdf6f3bd220806b837dab380cab.png)

No longer is the fear of your dog dying, with dog beds. Simply sit your dog on a dog bed, and they'll respawn at that bed. Dog beds can be crafted with all 16 carpets allowing you to customize your dog a bit more.

### **Dog Bowls**
![Dog bowl recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc375a6b95abf8d7f7ac401ae1c21f94c17c3046.png)

Tired of manually feeding your dog? Well say hello to the dog bowl. Interact with the dog bowl while holding food to fill it up. When your dog is servely injured, it will eat from the bowl and regenerate it's health automatically.

### **Dog Weapons**
![A dog attacking a zombie with a diamond sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb7c9c0d5203e30eec5e0a08693e74a26c1eed0c.png)

Interact with your dog while holding a weapon to give it to them. The dog must be equipped with dog armor before being given a weapon. Note: Crouch to sit your dog.

### **Throwable bones and sticks**
![A bone being thrown](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/294d195c351e356dab448456561c8da307ef5fb3_0.webp)

You are now able to throw sticks and bones. Doing so will cause nearby dogs to chase it, which can be used to distract them. If you don't want to throw a bone or stick, simply crouch.

### **Dog Aggression Levels**
![A player changing a dog's aggression level using a stick](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef17a58b607d6ed32f579ba6a6a324c253828f3e.png)

Interacting with a tamed dog while holding a stick cycles it through 3 aggression levels, passive, neutral, and hostile. Passive dogs won't attack anything, neutral dogs will only attack skeletons and anything that damages or is damaged by their owner, and hostile dogs will attack all hostile mobs nearby.
